incidents.summary: Guernsey's Data Protection Authority found that Watches of Switzerland breached the right of access after failing to identify relevant personal information when responding to a customer's data subject access request.

sources.title: Enforcement Order issued to Watches of Switzerland Company Limited | ODPA
sources.quote: In November 2024, the Authority received a complaint from an individual in relation to a Data Subject Access Request (“DSAR”) they submitted to Mappin & Webb (part of the WoS group).

sources.title: Enforcement Order issued to Watches of Switzerland Company Limited | ODPA
sources.quote: During the Authority’s investigation, WoS located additional material relating to the Complainant which they had failed to identify during the initial DSAR process.

sources.title: Enforcement Order issued to Watches of Switzerland Company Limited | ODPA

positives: The Science Based Targets initiative verified the group's near-term emissions reduction target.
The group linked financing costs on its £225 million revolving credit facility to sustainability performance, including annual greenhouse gas emissions reductions.
